scope: the separate City of Los Angeles settlement (also identify any subsequent payment explicitly reported in the packet)

excerpts.locator: San Diego Gas & Electric Form 10-Q for June 30, 2007 (signed August 2, 2007), Note 8, Legal Proceedings, Continental Forge Settlement, p. 18, paragraph beginning 'On March 26, 2007'
excerpts.text: On March 26, 2007, Sempra Energy and the Sempra Utilities entered into a separate agreement with the City of Los Angeles to settle the City's Continental Forge claims in exchange for an April 25, 2007 payment of USD 8.5 million. It replaced the City's USD 12 million in eight annual installments under the January 2006 California settlement.

excerpts.locator: Same Form 10-Q, Note 8, Continental Forge Settlement, p. 19, paragraph beginning 'Under the terms of the City of Los Angeles settlement', first sentence
excerpts.text: The filing reports that USD 8.5 million under the separate City settlement was paid on April 25, 2007.
